```{r setup, include=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

source("Libraries.R")
merged_data <- read.csv("Input/merged_data.csv")

# metto a posto la tipologia di variabile
cols_date <- c("Data_di_nascita", "Data_esordio", "Data_diagnosi", "Data_prelievo_T0", "data_referto_T6", "data_referto_T12", "data_referto_T18", "data_referto_T24", "data_referto_T30", "data_referto_T36", "data_cambio_terapia", "sample_collection_date", "glc_date_before_t0")
merged_data[cols_date] <- lapply(merged_data[cols_date], as.Date)
cols_factor <- c("lesioni_T6", "relapse_T6", "lesioni_T12", "relapse_T12", "lesioni_T18", "relapse_T18", "lesioni_T24", "relapse_T24", "lesioni_T30", "relapse_T30", "lesioni_T36", "relapse_T36", "cambio_terapia", "lesion_burden", "bone_marrow_lesions", "subtentorial_lesions", "gadolinium_contrast", "full_recovery")
merged_data[cols_factor] <- lapply(merged_data[cols_factor], factor, levels = c("No", "Yes"))
cols_factor2 <- c("naive", "smoking_habit", "antibiotic_use", "spike_in")
merged_data[cols_factor2] <- lapply(merged_data[cols_factor2], factor, levels = c("Yes", "No"))
cols_factor3 <- c("glucocorticoid_treatment", "gc_treatment", "prognosis_at_onset")
merged_data[cols_factor3] <- lapply(merged_data[cols_factor3], factor, levels = c("Positive", "Negative"))
merged_data$physical_activity <- factor(merged_data$physical_activity, levels = c("active", "sedentary", "partially_active"))
merged_data$simplified_batch <- factor(merged_data$simplified_batch, levels = c("1-3", "4-5"))
merged_data$disease_activity <- factor(merged_data$disease_activity, levels = c("higher_activity", "lower_activity"))
merged_data$sex <- factor(merged_data$sex, levels = c("M", "F"))
merged_data$sequencing_batch <- factor(merged_data$sequencing_batch, levels = c("1", "2", "3"))
merged_data$CENTRO <- factor(merged_data$CENTRO, levels = c("CLERICO", "NAPOLI", "MOLINETTE", "CRESM"))
merged_data$clinical_presentation <- factor(merged_data$clinical_presentation)
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      starts_with("EDSS"),
      ~ ordered(as.numeric(.x), levels = seq(1, 10, by = 0.5))
    )
  )
cols_numeric <- c("MEDAS", "cortisone_T6", "cortisone_T12", "cortisone_T18", "cortisone_T24", "cortisone_T30", "cortisone_T36", "age_at_t0", "bmi", "dna_quantification", "days_gc_collection", "percent_th17", "treg_il10_pos", "treg_cd39_pos", "age")
merged_data[cols_numeric] <- lapply(merged_data[cols_numeric], as.numeric)

```


```{r summary, include=TRUE}
summary(merged_data)
summary(as.numeric(merged_data$EDSS_T0))
```

The cohort is composed by 30 patients affected by multiple sclerosis recruited from multiple centers (Clerico, Molinette, Napoli, CRESM).
All of them were treated with cladribine (Mavenclad).
The longitudinal clinical data were collected at 6-month time-points for 3 years.

The population is predominantly female, with 20 females (66.7%) and 9 males (30.0%).
At baseline (T0), the mean age was 37.37 years (± 9.89), with a median of 38.50 years, ranging from 20 to 55 years, indicating a relatively young cohort.
Disease activity was predominantly classified as higher activity.
Disability at baseline, measured by EDSS, showed generally low values reflected by a median of 3.0 and 26.7% of patients with a EDSS 1. 
About treatment history, 18 patients (60.0%) were naive, while 11 (36.7%) had received prior therapies.
Glucocorticoid treatment before T0 was reported in 12 patients (40.0%), whereas 6 patients (20.0%) had not received such treatment and data were missing for 12 subjects.

Regarding lifestyle factors, the mean body mass index (BMI) was 23.54 ± 4.85, ranging from 16.80 to 32.10, with 9 missing values.
Adherence to the Mediterranean diet, assessed by the MEDAS score (from 0 to 100), showed a mean value of 50.55 ± 15.18, with a wide range (35.00–85.70) and 8 missing observations.
7 patients (23.3%) are smokers and 17 (56.7%) are non-smokers, with 6 missing values.
Physical activity is heterogeneous distributed among the cohort with 5 (16.7%) patients classified as active, 7 (23.3%) as partially active and 9 (30%) as sedentary, with 9 missing values.

```{r table, include=TRUE}

####tabella riassuntiva stile paper

#variabili numeriche
tab_num <- merged_data %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("percent_th17", "treg_cd39_pos", "treg_il10_pos"))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "val") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(variable) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    All = paste0(round(mean(val, na.rm = TRUE), 2), " ± ", round(sd(val, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
    `N missing` = as.character(sum(is.na(val))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#variabili categoriche
vars_cat <- merged_data %>%
  dplyr::select(where(~is.factor(.) | is.character(.) | is.ordered(.)), 
                -any_of(c("ID", "NOTE", "nuova_terapia", "previous_therapy", "sample_type"))) %>%
  colnames()
lista_cat <- lapply(vars_cat, function(v) {
  miss_count <- as.character(sum(is.na(merged_data[[v]])))
  
levels_df <- merged_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(level = as.character(!!sym(v))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(level)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      All = paste0(n, " (", round((n / nrow(merged_data)) * 100, 1), "%)"),
      `N missing` = ""
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(variable = paste0("   ", level)) %>%
    dplyr::select(variable, All, `N missing`)
  
  bind_rows(
    tibble(variable = v, All = "", `N missing` = miss_count),
    levels_df
  )
})

tab_cat <- bind_rows(lista_cat)

#unione 
summary_table <- bind_rows(tab_num, tab_cat)

#visualizzazione nella parte di testo
knitr::kable(summary_table, booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE)

```

Exploratory analysis of some relevant demographic variables:
1. EDSS and age at T0, positive and significant difference between groups only in T24 and T30 timepoints (we have to consider that these two time-points have a larger number of NA).
```{r age, include=TRUE}

# EDSS vs age_at_t0
cor.test(merged_data$age_at_t0, as.numeric(merged_data$EDSS_T0), method = "spearman", exact = FALSE) # non significativo
cor.test(merged_data$age_at_t0, as.numeric(merged_data$EDSS_T12), method = "spearman", exact = FALSE) # non significativo
cor.test(merged_data$age_at_t0, as.numeric(merged_data$EDSS_T24), method = "spearman", exact = FALSE) #SIGNIFICATIVO
cor.test(merged_data$age_at_t0, as.numeric(merged_data$EDSS_T30), method = "spearman", exact = FALSE) #SIGNIFICATIVO

# linee di regressione EDSS vs age_at_t0
ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = age_at_t0, y = as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T0)))) + geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) + theme_minimal() + labs(title = "EDSS vs Age at T0", x = "Age_at_T0", y = "EDSS_T0")
ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = age_at_t0, y = as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T24)))) + geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) + theme_minimal() + labs(title = "EDSS vs Age at T0", x = "Age_at_T0", y = "EDSS_T24")

```

2. EDSS and sex, non-significant difference between groups at all time points.
```{r sex, include=TRUE}

# EDSS vs sex ##correlazione non significativa in nessun timepoint
wilcox.test(as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T0)) ~ sex, data = merged_data, exact = FALSE) # differenza non significativa
wilcox.test(as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T12)) ~ sex, data = merged_data, exact = FALSE) # differenza non significativa

``` 

Exploratory analysis of some relevant lifestyle factors:
1. Summary graph of the distribution of the BMI variable in the cohort:
```{r BMI, include=TRUE}
merged_data$bmi_class <- factor(case_when(
    merged_data$bmi < 18.5 ~ "Underweight",
    merged_data$bmi >= 18.5 & merged_data$bmi < 25 ~ "Normal_weight",
    merged_data$bmi >= 25 & merged_data$bmi < 30 ~ "Overweight",
    merged_data$bmi >= 30 ~ "Obese",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_),
  levels = c("Underweight", "Normal_weight", "Overweight", "Obese"),ordered = TRUE)

ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = bmi_class)) + geom_bar(fill = "#4C78A8", color = "white") + theme_minimal()

```

1.1. EDSS and BMI, non-significant difference between groups at all time points.
```{r bmi, include=TRUE}

cor.test(merged_data$bmi, as.numeric(merged_data$EDSS_T0), method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
cor.test(merged_data$bmi, as.numeric(merged_data$EDSS_T12), method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)

```

2. EDSS and smoking_habit, non-significant difference between groups at all time points.
```{r smoking, include=TRUE}

# EDSS vs smoking_habit #correlazione non significativa in nessun timepoint

wilcox.test(as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T12)) ~ smoking_habit, data = merged_data, exact = FALSE) # differenza non significativa
```

3. EDSS and physical_activity, a possible trend of relationship is observed between the sedentary lifestyle and an increase in the disability index (EDSS).
```{r activity, include=TRUE}
## EDSS vs physical_activity

#T0
ggplot(subset(merged_data, !is.na(physical_activity) & !is.na(EDSS_T0)), aes(x = physical_activity, y = as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T0)), fill = physical_activity)) + geom_boxplot() + theme_minimal() + labs(title = "EDSS vs Physical_activity", x = "Physical_activity", y = "EDSS_T0")

#T24
ggplot(subset(merged_data, !is.na(physical_activity) & !is.na(EDSS_T24)), aes(x = physical_activity, y = as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T24)), fill = physical_activity)) + geom_boxplot() + theme_minimal() + labs(title = "EDSS vs Physical_activity", x = "Physical_activity", y = "EDSS_T24")

#andamento totale
edss_long <- merged_data %>%
  select(ID, smoking_habit, sex, naive, physical_activity, EDSS_T0, EDSS_T6, EDSS_T12, EDSS_T18, EDSS_T24, EDSS_T30) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("EDSS"), names_to = "time", values_to = "EDSS_val") %>%
  mutate(EDSS_val = as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_val)), sex = trimws(as.character(sex)), time = factor(time, levels = c("EDSS_T0","EDSS_T6","EDSS_T12","EDSS_T18","EDSS_T24","EDSS_T30"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(EDSS_val))
ggplot(edss_long, aes(x = time, y = EDSS_val, color = physical_activity, group = physical_activity)) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", size = 3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  theme_minimal() + labs(title="EDSS during time by Physical Activity", x = "Time", y = "Median EDSS")

```

Exploratory analysis of some relevant clinical-radiological variables
1. Age at T0 and relapse, non-significant difference between groups at all time points.
```{r relapse, include=TRUE}

# age_at_t0 vs relapse
t.test(age_at_t0 ~ relapse_T6, data = merged_data)
t.test(age_at_t0 ~ relapse_T24, data = merged_data) 

```

2. Age at T0 and lesions, positive and significant difference between groups on T6 an T12.
```{r lesions, include=TRUE}

# age_at_t0 vs lesions
t.test(age_at_t0 ~ lesioni_T6, data = merged_data) # correlazione SIGNIFICATIVA (di poco)
t.test(age_at_t0 ~ lesioni_T12, data = merged_data) # correlazione SIGNIFICATIVA
t.test(age_at_t0 ~ lesioni_T24, data = merged_data) # correlazione non significativa

```

3. EDSS and lesion burden, non-significant difference between groups at all time points, but looking at the graph you can notice a possible trend of association of higher EDSS values to patients with lesions.
```{r lesion burden, include=TRUE}

#lesion burden
wilcox.test(as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T0)) ~ lesion_burden, data = merged_data, exact = FALSE) 
wilcox.test(as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T12)) ~ lesion_burden, data = merged_data, exact = FALSE) 

merged_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(EDSS_T0), !is.na(lesion_burden)) %>%
  mutate(
    EDSS_T0 = as.factor(EDSS_T0),
    lesion_burden = factor(lesion_burden, labels = c("No", "Yes"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = lesion_burden, fill = EDSS_T0)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "mako") + theme_minimal() + labs(title = "EDSS_T0 by lesion burden", x = "Lesion burden", y = "Percentage", fill = "EDSS")

```

4. EDSS and bone marrow lesions, non-significant difference between groups at all time points, but looking at the graph you can notice a trend of association of higher EDSS values to patients with lesions.

6. EDSS and gadolinium contrast, non-significant difference between groups at all time points.
```{r gadolinium contrast, include=TRUE}
#gadolinium contrast
wilcox.test(as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T0)) ~ gadolinium_contrast, data = merged_data, exact = FALSE)
wilcox.test(as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T12)) ~ gadolinium_contrast, data = merged_data, exact = FALSE)
```

7. Glucocorticoid treatment before baseline and EDSS, significant positive difference between groups in the T0 timepoint.
```{r gc treatment, include=TRUE}
#glucocorticoid treatment before T0 e edss T0 #SIGNIFICATIVO
wilcox.test(as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T0)) ~ gc_treatment, data = merged_data)
ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = gc_treatment, y = as.numeric(as.character(EDSS_T0)))) + geom_boxplot() + theme_minimal() + labs(title= "gc_treatment before T0", x= "gc_treatment", y="EDSS T0")

```

Overall, no statistically significant associations were observed between EDSS and most clinical or lifestyle variables across time points. Physical activity showed a potential trend, with more sedentary patients displaying higher EDSS values over time. Age at baseline was positively associated with EDSS only at later time points, although these results may be influenced by missing data.
